warnings.message: Pin versions in apk add. Instead of `apk add <package>` use `apk add <package>=<version>`
Using latest is prone to errors if the image will ever update. Pin the version explicitly to a release tag

suggestions.message: Avoid use of wget without progress bar. Use `wget --progress=dot:giga <url>`. Or consider using `-q` or `-nv` (shorthands for `--quiet` or `--no-verbose`).
Use the `--no-cache` switch to avoid the need to use `--update` and remove `/var/cache/apk/*` when done installing packages
